arxiv-1707-00527.creator: Emmanuel Filiot \rsuper a, Olivier Gauwin \rsuper b, Pierre-Alain Reynier \rsuper c, Frédéric Servais \rsuper d
arxiv-1707-00527.description: A 2017 arXiv research paper by Emmanuel Filiot \rsuper a, Olivier Gauwin \rsuper b, Pierre-Alain Reynier \rsuper c, Frédéric Servais \rsuper d. We consider the problem of evaluating in streaming (i.e., in a single left-to-right pass) a nested word transduction with a limited amount of memory. A transduction T is said to be height bounded memory (HBM) if it can be evaluated with a memory that depends only on the size of T and on the height of the input word.

arxiv-2105-04908.title: Video Surveillance for Road Traffic Monitoring
arxiv-2105-04908.creator: Pol Albacar Òscar Lorente Eduard Mainou Ian Riera Universitat Politècnica de Catalunya {pol.albacar oscar.lorente eduard.mainou ian.pau.riera}@estudiantat.upc.edu
arxiv-2105-04908.description: Abstract This paper presents the learned techniques during the Video Analysis Module of the Master in Computer Vision from the Universitat Autònoma de Barcelona, used to solve the third track of the AI-City Challenge [ 1 ] . This challenge aims to track vehicles across multiple cameras placed in multiple intersections spread out over a city.

We investigate the integer quantum Hall effect in Cd 3 ​ As 2 \mathrm{Cd_{3}As_{2}} thin films under conditions of strong to moderate quantum confinement (thicknesses of 10 nm, 12 nm, 15 nm).

arxiv-2212-01311.title: Disjoint faces in simple drawings of the complete graph and topological Heilbronn problems
arxiv-2212-01311.creator: Alfredo Hubard, Andrew Suk
arxiv-2212-01311.description: Abstract Given a complete simple topological graph G G , a k k -face generated by G G is the open bounded region enclosed by the edges of a non-self-intersecting k k -cycle in G G . Interestingly, there are complete simple topological graphs with the property that every odd face it generates contains the origin.

arxiv-2301-10572.title: The Hubble constant tension: current status and future perspectives through new cosmological probes
arxiv-2301-10572.creator: Gaetano Lambiase
arxiv-2301-10572.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Gaetano Lambiase. The Hubble constant ( H 0 H_{0} ) tension is one of the major open problems in modern cosmology. This tension is the discrepancy, ranging from 4 to 6 σ \sigma , between the H 0 H_{0} value estimated locally with the combination of Supernovae Ia (SNe Ia) + Cepheids and the cosmological H 0 H_{0} obtained through the study of the Cosmic Microwave Background (CMB) radiation. The approaches adopted in [ 1 ] and [ 2 ] are introduced.

arxiv-2305-10846.creator: HEYNINCK JESSE, BOGAERTS BART
arxiv-2305-10846.description: Abstract Approximation fixpoint theory (AFT) is an abstract and general algebraic framework for studying the semantics of non-monotonic logics. In recent work, AFT was generalized to non-deterministic operators, i.e. operators whose range are sets of elements rather than single elements.

arxiv-2308-07890.title: EduSAT: A Pedagogical Tool for Theory and Applications of Boolean Satisfiability
arxiv-2308-07890.creator: Yiqi Zhao, Ziyan An, Meiyi Ma, Taylor Johnson
arxiv-2308-07890.description: Abstract Boolean Satisfiability (SAT) and Satisfiability Modulo Theories (SMT) are widely used in automated verification, but there is a lack of interactive tools designed for educational purposes in this field. To address this gap, we present EduSAT, a pedagogical tool specifically developed to support learning and understanding of SAT and SMT solving.

arxiv-2402-04371.creator: Gregory J. Loges
arxiv-2402-04371.description: Abstract We present a new infinite class of non-abelian, 6d supergravities with eight supercharges. These theories not only satisfy all known low-energy consistency conditions, such as being free of anomalies, but also evade the constraints arising from the consistency of string probes, even after assuming BPS completeness.

arxiv-2407-07883.title: Non–generic components of the Emerton–Gee stack for GL 2 \GL_{2}
arxiv-2407-07883.creator: Kalyani Kansal, Ben Savoie
arxiv-2407-07883.description: Abstract . Let K K be a finite unramified extension of 𝐐 p {\mathbf{Q}}_{p} with p > 3 p>3 . We study the extremely non–generic irreducible components in the reduced part of the Emerton–Gee stack for GL 2 \GL_{2} . We show precisely which irreducible components are smooth, which are normal, and which have Gorenstein normalizations.

arxiv-2503-07275.title: Automatic Curriculum Design for Zero-Shot Human-AI Coordination
arxiv-2503-07275.creator: Won-Sang You, Tae-Gwan Ha, Seo-Young Lee, Kyung-Joong Kim
arxiv-2503-07275.description: Abstract Zero-shot human-AI coordination is the training of an ego-agent to coordinate with humans without human data. Most studies on zero-shot human-AI coordination have focused on enhancing the ego-agent’s coordination ability in a given environment without considering the issue of generalization to unseen environments.

arxiv-2508-05999.title: Between Tool and Trouble: Student Attitudes Toward AI in Programming Education
arxiv-2508-05999.creator: Sergio Rojas-Galeano 1, Julian Tejada 2, Fernando Marmolejo-Ramos 3
arxiv-2508-05999.description: Abstract This study examines how AI code assistants shape novice programmers’ experiences during a two-part exam in an introductory programming course. In the first part, students completed a programming task with access to AI support; in the second, they extended their solutions without AI. We collected Likert-scale and open-ended responses from 20 students to evaluate their perceptions and challenges.

pmc-10738331.creator: Unknown
pmc-10738331.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). ObjectivesThis study aimed to develop a cognitive impairment screening tool based on eye tracking technology (ET-CIS), and apply ET-CIS to community-dwelling older adults to evaluated its screening performance.MethodsET-CIS were developed based on through systematic review, pre-experiments and expert consultation. We recruited older people in the community from July 2022 to November 2022 and collected data including demographics data, Montreal cognitive assessment, the mini-mental state examination, ET-CIS. The t-test and correlation analysis were conducted to screen out statistically significant parameters with of ET-CIS.

pmc-11339001.creator: Heng Yu, Hang Jiang, Xiaofeng Lu, Chunhua Bai, Peng Song, Feng Sun, Shichao Ai, Yi Yin, Qiongyuan Hu, Song Liu, Xin Chen, Junfeng Du, Xiaofei Shen, Wenxian Guan

pmc-11510947.title: Efficient Uranium Removal from Aqueous Solutions Using Silica-Based Adsorbents Functionalized with Various Polyamines
pmc-11510947.creator: Ping Zhang, Hongling Wang, Lifeng Chen, Wenlong Li, Toyohisa Fujita, Shunyan Ning, Yuezhou Wei
pmc-11510947.description: With the rapid development of nuclear energy, the contamination of environmental water systems by uranium has become a significant threat to human health. To efficiently remove uranium from these systems, three types of silica-based polyamine resins—SiPMA-DETA (SiPMA: silica/poly methyl acrylate; DETA: diethylenetriamine), SiPMA-TETA (TETA: triethylenetetramine), and SiPMA-TEPA (TEPA: tetraethylenepentamine)—were successfully prepared, characterized, and evaluated in batch experiments.

pmc-11521266.title: Inferring gender from first names: Comparing the accuracy of Genderize, Gender API, and the gender R package on authors of diverse nationality
pmc-11521266.creator: Alexander D. VanHelene, Ishaani Khatri, C. Beau Hilton, Sanjay Mishra, Ece D. Gamsiz Uzun, Jeremy L. Warner, Miguel Ángel Armengol de la Hoz, Miguel Ángel Armengol de la Hoz, Miguel Ángel Armengol de la Hoz
pmc-11521266.description: Meta-researchers commonly leverage tools that infer gender from first names, especially when studying gender disparities. However, tools vary in their accuracy, ease of use, and cost. The objective of this study was to compare the accuracy and cost of the commercial software Genderize and Gender API, and the open-source gender R package.

pmc-12656091.title: Acousto-Electronic Sensor Based on Langmuir-Blodgett Films of Tetra-Tert-Butylphthalocyaninate Zinc for Chemical Vapor Detection
pmc-12656091.creator: Ilya Gorbachev, Andrey Smirnov, Vladimir Kolesov, Alexey Yagodin, Alexander Martynov, Yulia Gorbunova, Iren Kuznetsova, Roger Narayan
pmc-12656091.description: In this work, the sensor properties of multilayered Langmuir-Blodgett (LB) films of tetra-tert-butylphthalocyaninate zinc (tBuZnPc) were studied using an acoustoelectronic method. The morphology and optical properties of the fabricated films were characterized by atomic force microscopy and ultraviolet-visible spectroscopy, respectively. The LB films were deposited on surface acoustic wave (SAW) delay lines, and their gas-sensing properties were investigated.

pmc-12768800.title: PP40 Enoxaparin: Synthesis of Evidence for Expanding the Current National Clinical Protocol and Therapeutic Guidelines
pmc-12768800.creator: Gleidson Cardoso Spinola, Bárbara de Castro dos Santos Silva, Carolina Santos Silva, Manuela Fernandes de Almeida Mello, Rouseli Gonçalves de Menezes
pmc-12768800.description: Introduction Venous thromboembolism (VTE) prevention for women with additional risk factors during pregnancy is centered on anticoagulant therapy, with enoxaparin as the anticoagulant of fchoice. This study evaluated the efficacy, safety, and costs of enoxaparin for thromboprophylaxis in pregnant or postpartum women at risk for VTE, aiming to expand access to the Brazilian national Clinical Protocols and Therapeutic Guidelines (PCDT).
